column1: # AN-2 (D-126) real-capture annotation trace — evidence fixture, not synthetic.
# Every Annotation the production detect -> track -> measure -> annotate
# pipeline (phosphene-analyze, full D-125 coverage, 250ms cycles) produced
# while replaying the owner's own 913 MHz ISM-band capture end to end:
# ~/captures/cap_913MHz_5Msps.sc16 (30s, 5 MS/s, gain 60, cs16 — D-126's
# reference scene, gain measured not guessed, zero clipping end to end).
# Columns (tab-separated): cycle_index cycle_time_s track_id low_hz high_hz
# anchor_hz confidence strength_db label
# Regenerate by replaying that capture through Detector::new(DetectorConfig
# ::new()) + Tracker::new(TrackerConfig::default()) + Measurer::new
# (MeasureConfig::default()) + build_annotation, one cycle every
# round(0.25s / (1024/5_000_000)) = 1221 raw FFT frames (1024-pt Hann,
# center 913_000_000.0 Hz), draining detector.finish() at each cycle's last
# new frame and chaining tracker.drain_retired() (mirrors phosphene-app's
# AnalysisState::cycle exactly). 119 full cycles fit in the 30s file; the
# ~242ms remainder is discarded, matching a finite run's own boundary.
# Amendment 1 item 4 (diff-size): trimmed to cycles 0-45 (~11.5s, 667 rows)
# of the full 119-cycle/1346-row capture, so the review diff stays under
# the one-pass threshold. Cut: cycles 46-118 (~19.5s, 679 rows) — the same
# CFAR-flood collision pressure and at least one real signal (a 15-52dB
# hopper-band burst recurring near 911.9 MHz, cycles 9/26/33/45 in the
# original numbering) are both still present in this window.
# Amendment 2: the placement-ladder degrade rate this fixture drives is a
# single number, computed from this window and asserted directly, by
# an2_label_placement_evidence.rs's an2_placement_ladder_degrades_most_
# admitted_labels — read that test's own assertions and printed output for
# the number, not this header (Amendment 2 item 3: no prose baseline here).
# Used by an2_label_placement_evidence.rs to replay this exact real-world
# annotation sequence through the REAL phosphene-render draw() entry point
# (not a re-implementation of its wiring), cross-checked every frame
# against an independently computed prediction — no live radio, no
# host-local file, and fully deterministic. overlay.rs itself ships this
# lane unchanged from main (Amendment 2); the regression this fixture's
# tests can still catch is production drifting from the §2.3/AC-3 contract
# they predict against (an2_shadow_prediction_matches_production_rendering
# — see that test's own doc comment for how to reproduce its red).
